mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen steadily for four consecutive weeks (-40.7 to -26.9), indicating a sustained recovery trend driven by easing restrictions; this momentum is expected to continue, pushing the next-4-week mean above the last-4-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved every week from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Next-28-day mean RETAIL_REC is lower than or equal to the last-28-day mean despite the four-week monotonic improvement trend.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has declined each week (19.1 to 13.7) while TRANSIT has risen (-35.0 to -20.1), signaling people are spending less time at home and moving more via transit, which mechanically feeds into higher retail and recreation visits over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 2 weeks even though RESIDENTIAL continues to fall and TRANSIT continues to rise in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES mobility drops more than 5 points week-on-week (as seen between t-2w and t-1w, -24.1 to -26.0), this signals a policy tightening episode that will suppress discretionary retail trips within one week due to reduced commuter-linked shopping.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped from -24.1 to -26.0 between t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat within 1 week following a WORKPLACES week-on-week drop exceeding 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp and consistent rebound in PARKS (-52.6 to -34.9) reflects relaxation of outdoor gathering restrictions; such policy easing typically precedes broader retail reopening within four weeks as restrictions on indoor venues follow outdoor ones.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved by nearly 18 points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 4 weeks despite PARKS continuing its upward trajectory at a similar pace.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has risen from 0.0 to 19.0 over four weeks, an unusually large increase; if this signals pantry-loading or pharmacy stockpiling ahead of anticipated restriction tightening, discretionary retail trips (RETAIL_REC) may be deprioritized and fall over the next 2 weeks as households substitute essential for non-essential shopping.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises more than 15 points over 4 weeks while RETAIL_REC remains negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 2 weeks despite GROCERY_PHARM maintaining or exceeding its current elevated level.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT mobility crosses above -20 points (threshold breached at t-0w: -20.1), this indicates commuting and movement have normalized enough to materially support retail footfall recovery within the following week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT reached -20.1 at t-0w, near the -20 threshold
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the week following TRANSIT crossing above -20 points.

mechanism_narrative: The decision date (2022-04-15) falls near the Easter/spring holiday period in Hong Kong; seasonal recreational travel and shopping typically rise during this period regardless of prior trend, boosting RETAIL_REC over the next 4 weeks independent of other mobility signals.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date 2022-04-15 falls within spring holiday season
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 4 weeks despite the holiday period and continued PARKS improvement.

mechanism_narrative: The joint co-movement of rising WORKPLACES, TRANSIT, and PARKS alongside falling RESIDENTIAL over four weeks represents a coordinated de-isolation regime change; when all four series move in the de-isolation direction simultaneously for two or more consecutive weeks, RETAIL_REC recovery accelerates beyond what any single series would predict, due to compounding social and economic reopening effects.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES, TRANSIT, and PARKS all rise while RESIDENTIAL falls for 2+ consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC growth over the next 4 weeks is not greater than what a single-series model (e.g. TRANSIT alone) would predict, despite all four series co-moving in the de-isolation direction.
